description_en: deep traditional grain-carrying basket with woven body and a broad asymmetrical rim; front pouring lip, right side cord handle, rear reinforced tall wall
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference image is the canonical FRONT. Render ONE photorealistic RIGHT-SIDE azimuth90, exact profile of THAT EXACT SAME OBJECT, rotating only the camera. Right cord handle nearest camera, front low pouring lip at image-left and tall rear wall at image-right, same asymmetrical rim. Keep exact material, finish, weave, dimensions, bindings, handles, cavities and natural resting/display pose of the reference. Match sensible elevation, warm-white seamless background, soft light, scale and framing. Whole object centered with margins. No three-quarter azimuth, mirroring, detached objects, props, people, food, animals or plants. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermark or measurements.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
